# OAKit

> OAKit turns Office documents into deterministic, bounded, and traceable knowledge for AI-agent workflows, starting with PowerPoint support.

- [Documentation](https://oakit.evoelsewhere.asia/docs): Product overview and current format support.
- [Quickstart](https://oakit.evoelsewhere.asia/docs/quickstart): Installation, package API, CLI, and safe defaults.
- [API reference](https://oakit.evoelsewhere.asia/docs/api): Public exports and import paths.
- [Parsing PPTX](https://oakit.evoelsewhere.asia/docs/api/parse-pptx): Parser signatures, inputs, options, defaults, and guarantees.
- [Document model](https://oakit.evoelsewhere.asia/docs/api/document-model): Field-level PPTX output reference.
- [Diagnostics and limits](https://oakit.evoelsewhere.asia/docs/api/diagnostics): Error modes, diagnostic codes, and resource boundaries.
- [Command line](https://oakit.evoelsewhere.asia/docs/cli): Commands, output envelopes, errors, and exit codes.
- [Browser integration](https://oakit.evoelsewhere.asia/docs/browser): Local parsing, media modes, cleanup, and workers.
- [Agent tools](https://oakit.evoelsewhere.asia/docs/agent-tools): Bounded, traceable, untrusted-data tool patterns.
- [Agent guides](https://oakit.evoelsewhere.asia/guides): Patterns for ingestion, provenance, retrieval, and prompt-injection boundaries.
- [Architecture](https://oakit.evoelsewhere.asia/architecture): Package layers and processing boundaries.
- [Changelog](https://oakit.evoelsewhere.asia/changelog): Release notes and release gates.
- [Source](https://github.com/evoelsewhere/oakit): OAKit source repository.

Current status: pre-stable. PPTX reading is in development; XLSX and DOCX remain planned. Verify claims against the published package version before relying on them in production.
